QVE-01.title: PostgreSQL transactions atomically commit call state and outbox rows
QVE-01.notes: Local: atomic state+outbox with a simulated crash before COMMIT (reliability.pg.test.mjs). Missing: real database process crash mid-COMMIT on staging.

QVE-02.title: Redis down during call creation: event retained, later delivered
QVE-02.notes: Local: Redis stopped/started under a stream of events, complete and in order across two replicas; Redis over TLS with a private CA, least-privilege ACL (evidence/rc2/QVE-02-11_redis-tls_local). Missing: staging Redis with a real certificate chain, 2-minute outage under load. Re-run on this revision: Redis TLS 3/3 (evidence/rc2-v2/runs).

QVE-03.title: Crash after publish before outbox acknowledgment: replay/dedupe correct
QVE-03.notes: Local: per-account in-order delivery with racing workers, poison events, hung publish, dead worker, marking retry. Missing: ordering under load on separate hosts.

QVE-04.title: Two voice nodes: cross-node call, answer, ICE exchange
QVE-04.notes: Local: two in-process replicas and a two-container compose with 15 smoke checks, one machine. Missing: two separate hosts behind a real load balancer.

QVE-05.title: Server restart: missed events replay, state converges
QVE-05.notes: Local: replica killed and replaced mid-call; engine killed and restarted under two real browsers. Missing: staged rolling restart with measured convergence.

QVE-06.title: Device takeover: stale lease cannot signal or continue media
QVE-06.notes: Local: stale generation dropped, takeover in two real browsers. Missing: physical devices.

QVE-07.title: Concurrent calls and idempotency under load
QVE-07.notes: Local: concurrency tests; one load run on one machine (100 pairs, 300 calls, 6000 signals, 0 errors). Missing: independent staging load and 8-hour soak.

QVE-08.notes: Local: Chromium mic refusal, hangup, ICE restart (also both sides at once), relay-only call through a real coturn on this machine. Missing: other browsers, real networks.

QVE-09.title: Two physical devices on different networks with real audio
QVE-09.notes: Not done: no physical-device or cross-network test.

QVE-10.title: Redis/Postgres failure, recovery, backpressure, restart
QVE-10.notes: Local: Redis stop/start, database connections killed, fail-closed backlog. Missing: PostgreSQL primary failover with measured RTO/RPO.
